description: This file contains unit tests for the ThemeService class, verifying functionalities such as theme variable retrieval, image fetching, and social media image visibility within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding module.

classes.name: ThemeServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ThemeService functions such as theme variable retrieval, image handling, and social media icon display logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by populating fixture data for themes.

methods.name: testShowSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Verifies the visibility of social media images under different theme conditions.

methods.name: testGetCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Checks if theme CSS variables are correctly retrieved and cached for custom and default themes.

methods.name: testGetImageETagWithNullImage
methods.description: Ensures that requesting an ETag for a null image returns null.

methods.name: testGetImage
methods.description: Validates that the correct logo image is retrieved.

methods.name: testGetImageWithNullImage
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving an image when none exists returns null.
